title: teamLab to Open Biggest Museum Yet in Tokyo
paragraphs: teamLab, the Japanese art group famous for its digital art museums, is planning to build its biggest museum ever in Tokyo.

The new museum will have the temporary name "teamLab Tokyo." It will be built in Ariake, an area on Tokyo Bay next to Odaiba. According to reports, it will cover about 30,000 to 33,000 square meters, making it the largest facility the group has ever built. However, visitors will have to wait a long time. The museum is planned to open in 2032, about six years from now.

The museum will have digital art, as well as plazas and cafes. It will also be surrounded by trees and plants, which will create a "small forest." The nearest station will be Ariake Tennis no Mori on the Yurikamome Line, so visitors will be able to walk there easily.

teamLab was started in 2001. The group combines art, science and technology. In its museums, visitors walk through rooms filled with light, color and moving images, and the artworks often change when people touch them or move near them.

teamLab's museums are already very popular. Tokyo currently has two of them: teamLab Borderless in Azabudai Hills and teamLab Planets in Toyosu. Together, they had about 4.2 million visitors in 2025. teamLab Borderless used to be in Odaiba, but it moved to Azabudai in 2024. Since then, it has had more than four million visitors.
The name, size and opening date of the new museum may still change. According to some reports, teamLab Planets is expected to close at the end of 2027.
The Ariake area already has other places for visitors, such as the Ariake Garden complex and Tokyo Dream Park.
